description: This file defines functions and types for collecting and analyzing Telegram channel status issues, including account status and group membership audits, for integration with a larger system.

methods.name: readTelegramAccountStatus
methods.description: Reads and maps a ChannelAccountSnapshot to a TelegramAccountStatus object.

methods.name: readTelegramGroupMembershipAuditSummary
methods.description: Processes raw audit data into a structured TelegramGroupMembershipAuditSummary object.
